headline: 10 of 10 in 31:38, the second fastest MC the guild has logged, every boss under the median

mvp.headline: 97 average parse, never under 95, no deaths
why: 99 on Magmadar, Gehennas, Majordomo and Ragnaros, 95 to 97 on the other six
Most damage in the raid on Majordomo, and alive all night

also.text: most damage in the raid on Lucifron, Gehennas, Garr, Geddon, Golemagg and Ragnaros
top healer on Gehennas, Garr, Geddon and Golemagg

overview: A full clear in 31:38, second only to the 29:44 on 7 August and almost eleven minutes under the guild's usual MC (42:18). All ten bosses died faster than the guild's median, from Shazzrah (0:17 against 0:19) to Majordomo (0:45 against 1:04), and nobody wiped.
Nine deaths, five of them on trash between bosses. Raid DPS was above the guild's usual on every boss, most of all on Majordomo (22k against 15k) and Sulfuron (21k against 16k).

World buffs held up through the raid: Rallying Cry and Zandalar on 31 to 33 of the 39 raiders on every boss, Mol'dar's Moxie on 27 or more. Songflower and Rend ran out as the evening went on (Songflower on 27 at Lucifron, 7 by Majordomo).

Skoomael, coming off a 97 average in BWL an hour earlier, managed 86 here, with 61 on Gehennas and 73 on Lucifron, and was exactly as good as the average raider at not standing in Inferno, Arcane Explosion and Lava Burst. He also played the first eight bosses with no world buffs at all: all seven reappeared on the trash before Majordomo, where he promptly parsed 96 and then 99 on Ragnaros.

wentWell.text: Majordomo in 0:45 against a median of 1:04, five seconds off the guild record. Drikkle 99, Yulepunch 97, Hjärterkung 96.
Ragnaros in 0:50 (median 1:01) with nobody dead. Skoomael and Drikkle 99.
Baron Geddon in 0:33 against a median of 0:42. Living Bomb caught only two other raiders, a quarter of the usual.
Magmadar's Lava Bomb fire hit one raider all fight, where a usual kill sees about two hits per raider.

0:33 against a median of 0:42. 12 Ignite Manas dispelled; the Living Bomb caught two people.
